propositions: _paged_search loops indefinitely when a Jira DC server ignores startAt offsets and returns the same page repeatedly, as verified by a test stub making 26 calls against a page-capping server that advances no further
Fail-open exception handlers at get_parent_map and three fetch_snapshot enrichment sites swallow any abort signal from the pager, converting it to silent degradation instead of propagating the error
A guard that checks if a page repeats the previous page's first issue key will fire on the second call when the server is not honouring offset advancement
The stall error must be defined in core _backend.py rather than in adapters so that fetcher.py can name it without importing from adapters and breaking layering

A startAt-ignoring DC server that serves 20 of 250 issues per page would silently return a 92%-truncated snapshot when only adopting fetcher's short-page branch, making DC-specific guard logic necessary
Four exception-handler sites must re-raise the stall error before their broad except Exception clauses to prevent a transport-level abort from being neutralized into a degraded snapshot
